mapper.insert: INSERT INTO farm (organization_id, farm_code, name, owner_user_id, main_crop_id, address, memo, lifecycle_status, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{farmCode}, #{name}, #{ownerUserId}, #{mainCropId}, #{address}, #{memo}, #{lifecycleStatus}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_id, farm_code, name, owner_user_id, main_crop_id, address, memo, lifecycle_status, status, structure_version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted_at FROM farm WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT organization_id FROM farm WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM organization WHERE id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, organization_id, farm_code, name, owner_user_id, main_crop_id, address, memo, lifecycle_status, status, structure_version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted_at FROM farm WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE farm SET structure_version = structure_version + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.name, f.farm_code, f.address, f.lifecycle_status, f.status, fm.role FROM farm f JOIN farm_member fm ON fm.farm_id = f.id WHERE fm.user_id = #{userId} AND fm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO farm_member (farm_id, user_id, role, status, created_at) VALUES (#{farmId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
